text: I scheduled my pickup through their app for 7–8 pm Sunday. Instead, I got a call from the store manager saying it was raining and they’d send the pickup guy the next day. I made the mistake of sending two Polo caps, and both were returned with faded colors.Consistency of Service:This wasn’t a one-time issue. text: I've been utilizing Fabrico's laundry and dry cleaning service for the last six months. Despite their efforts to position themselves as superior in the market, my experience reveals otherwise.
